ui_phy_mode.description: SPI mode (CPOL/CPHA). Curently only mode 0 and 3 are supported.

ui_encoder.description: Current encoder position as 16 bit signed integer

ui_inputs.description: Input pin state. Read from MCP23 GPIO register

ui_outputs.description: Control output pins. This value will be sent to the MCP23 OLAT register on write

ui_send_fb.description: Write anything to send framebuffer to SSD1322 once

ui_read_mcp.description: Write anything to read MCP inputs once

ui_enable_interrupt.description: Write 1 to fetch MCP inputs automatically on pin-change

ui_reset.description: Write anything to reset and re-initialize MCP23 and OLED. Takes 4 ms.

ui_event_invert.description: set a bit to invert the button value (active low)

ui_event_active.description: clear a bit to disable button

ui_event_t_long.description: time for long press in [10 ms]
